• Nvidia is investigated for possible GPU smuggling to China via Megaspeed, with focus on CEO Jensen Huang’s knowledge and relationships.
• Character.ai filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in October 2026 and planned to auction its user data, including private chats, to the highest bidder.
• Amazon and Meta are negotiating to lift the block on Muse’s ability to shop on Amazon, focusing on search and ad impacts.

items.text:
Character.ai faces a legal block on its data auction.

• The company filed Chapter 11 and planned to auction private chats.
• 42 state attorneys general say the dataset includes over 21 million accounts, 2.1 million minors.
• The AGs aim to stop the sale, warning it could violate privacy laws.
